data.content_ref: inline:The target commits to a self-contradictory causal structure by explicitly arguing that urban thermal mass is the *primary* driver of the nocturnal UHI ('primarily driven by the slower cooling rate of urban thermal mass'), while simultaneously arguing in its mechanism text that the *dominant modulator* of the nighttime gap is reduced sky view factor ('the dominant modulator of the gap is the reduced sky view factor'). The problem context demands identifying the single mechanism that best explains why the gap is larger in some cities. By stating both that thermal mass primarily drives the base effect and that sky view factor dominates the cross-city modulation, the target fails to isolate a single coherent mechanism, instead splitting the explanatory burden between two distinct physical processes and rendering its core thesis ambiguous.
